    How to use

    Bind top sheets

    1. Drop PDF files or a whole folder onto the window, or use Choose PDFs. New files are added in file-name order.
    2. Page 1 of each file appears as a numbered sheet. Drag sheets to re-arrange them. On a phone or tablet press and hold a sheet, then drag. The arrows move a sheet one place and Sort orders them by name or date.
    3. Name the file, then Print, Save, Save as or Share. Each page gets a bookmark with its source file name.

    Saving

    • Save puts the PDF in your Downloads folder.
    • Save as lets you choose the folder and file name. In Chrome and Edge on Windows or Mac a save window opens. On iPhone and iPad the share sheet opens: choose Save to Files, then pick the folder. In Safari or Firefox on a computer, turn on “Ask where to save each file” in the browser’s download settings.

    Sharing

    • Share offers WhatsApp, Facebook and Email. On iPhone, iPad and Android the phone’s share menu opens with the PDF attached: pick the app there.
    • On a computer, WhatsApp and Facebook save the PDF to Downloads and open the web app so you can attach it. Email prepares a new Outlook message with the PDF already attached. More apps opens the Windows or Mac share window when available.

    Printing

    • Chrome and Edge open the print dialog with the bound PDF.
    • Safari, iPhone and iPad prepare the pages first, then open the print dialog. For the sharpest print on iPhone you can also use Share › More apps › Print.
    • Mixed sizes (A4 with A3 drawings, for example) print scaled to the paper you choose in the print dialog.

    Secured or damaged PDFs

    • If a PDF is secured or damaged its first page is copied as a high-resolution image and marked Image copy. Password-protected files ask for the password.

    Use it like an app

    • Windows and Mac: open PDF File Top Sheet Extractor & Binder.html. It works offline.
    • iPhone and iPad: open the web app’s address in Safari, tap Share › Add to Home Screen.

    Keyboard: select a sheet, then use Alt + arrow keys to move it, Delete to remove it and Ctrl/⌘ + Z to undo.
